subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should OpenClaw add a built-in `/mark` command with six fixed presets and durable session metadata, or should this workflow use the existing session label/category and plugin surfaces?
rationale: The request adds a new core command, hardcoded product vocabulary, and persisted state rather than repairing an established behavior contract; code review cannot choose that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Use Existing Session Model
options.body: Keep core centered on `label` and `category`, and implement preset convenience through an existing UI or plugin surface without parallel durable label state.

options.title: Sponsor Core Marks
options.body: Accept `/mark` as a core feature, but require an independent canonical mark field, complete presentation integration, lifecycle tests, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Decline The Feature
options.body: Close the PR if fixed session-mark presets are not a desired permanent core capability.

recommendation.title: Use Existing Session Model
recommendation.body: Keep core centered on `label` and `category`, and implement preset convenience through an existing UI or plugin surface without parallel durable label state.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history shows the strongest recent ownership of session lifecycle behavior and core command structure.
